journey.name: Favorite an App Story
journey.description: Verifies that a user can bookmark / favorite an app story either directly from the feed or from the story detail page, and toggles the bookmark icon state.

actions.action: Verify that the app is on the "Discover" feed
Scroll until the app story "Xperiencia" is visible
Verify that the story detail screen for "Xperiencia" is displayed
Tap the bookmark icon in the top toolbar to favorite the app
Verify that the bookmark icon indicates favorited state ("★")
Tap the back button to return to the feed
Verify that the bookmark icon on the "Xperiencia" feed card indicates favorited state ("★")
